Amnesty International | NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration | Blue Origin | The White House | Parliament of the Republic of South Africa | European Parliament | UK Parliament |HYMN TO THE ARTEMIS II SPACE MISSION(*) Suziene CavalcanteFrom the furnaces of the Space Launch System rises a chant of fire… And the Orion becomes a verb hurled into the beautiful infinite!There go four human destinies, in magnanimous ventures…Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen:names that History will pronounce like constellations.Between Earth’s blue shadow and the Moon’s silvery glow,Four hearts carry the Planet, and will make of infinity a radiant road!Upon the fiery back of the Space Launch System, the human spirit ascends in the form of a vessel…And the Orion tears through the veil of the atmosphere like a luminous arrow aimed at eternity.Now courage wears no flags: it wears humanity… And every orbit traced in the dark is a new verse of our immortality!Where science kneels before mystery and, even so, dares to advance…O Moon, guardian of eternal silences…Nocturnal mirror of our gaze!O astronauts, children of Earth and pilgrims of the infinite!Within the capsule beats the heart of all the living…You beheld the Eternal in deep space!And humanity praising the Eternal… Thus, we were born to converse with the Universe, not merely to inhabit the world.Four hearts carry the ineffable Earth…Reid Wiseman, steadfast in command of the impossible!Victor Glover, guiding tomorrow with serene hands…Christina Koch, history hears the fullness of the feminine voice!Jeremy Hansen, science and faith in the Cosmos…They embrace the Moon with their eyes…And return bearing in their blessed suits…The invisible dust of infinity!NASA rekindles the trail of the stars…In the firmament, its banner dances!For the Moon no longer belongs to a single nation…But to the collective destiny of humankind!O Artemis, goddess of thresholds and crossings…Your name is now vessel, flame, return, poetry!Your mission is not only to arrive or to rise…It is to prove that we still know how to depart!And when the capsule once again touches the seas of Earth…It will not bring back only astronauts…But the ancient and forgotten certainty that sparkles within us…That we were born to look to the sky and answer the call of the stars!અંબાજી ,
